split.rule: Before inspecting features or phrase labels, sort families by SHA256(continuum-boundary-v1: + family ID); first 20 development, remaining 6 holdout. Only metadata prefixes were parsed to freeze this split.

evaluationSources.scope: Derived monophonic feature sequences: grace notes/rest events excluded, ties merged. Use rational IOI/duration fields, not known-buggy onsettick. Phrase-end annotations are separate evaluation labels. Lyrics, phrase indices/positions, precomputed model strengths and tonal metadata are excluded from inference. Compare cues separately and disclose possible transcription/rest leakage. No audio alignment or transfer to progressive/jazz phrasing is established.

evaluationSources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the acquired corpus and DCML annotations. Mozart compositions are public-domain repertoire; the performance, edition and annotations are not thereby public domain. Kept locally, not bundled with the app.

split.trainingRule: Additional supervised training only; fixed before reading these works. No new independent-accuracy claim. Exclude complete K330/K331 development and K457 holdout sonata lineages from this extra training set.

evaluationSources.scope: Actual Roland Batik performance MIDI, performed-repeat score MusicXML, note-level match files and score-note arrays linked by the authors to independent DCML analyses. Performance ticks must use the supplied note alignment; they are not score beats.

alignment.coordinate: Exact onset_div and duration_div at 48 ticks per quarter, verified against all MusicXML divisions. Printed quarter columns contain floating-point rounding; onset_beat follows metrical beat units and differs in compound meter.

alignment.durationPolicy: Sparse joined rows include phrase-only labels. Use successive chord-bearing rows for unfolded chord intervals, report inherited duration overlaps, do not blindly extend a folded duration through a repeat.
